make_verify: 2 PASS / 2 CHAIN-CHECKED, exit 0 (online); exit 2 RECORDED offline
timing_method: commit_to_verdict_s / deliver_to_paid_s are client wall-clock from a 3s poll (approx, not block-derived); not used as README claims

max_size_deliver.note: first measured on day-0 G6 (build-plan.md:54): a 65820 B enc deliver accepted on the keyless probe

bounty_is_keyed_throwaway: d3 is a keyed iteration account (make verify prints '1 key(s), own code'); the production bounty is created keyless on the global-contract hash in D5 and must pass `make verify --require-keyless`
verify_checks_hardened: pinned reads live view_state; worker asserts resolve.request_id==commit's execution_requested id + block-scoped key lookup; paid asserts PAID amount==AWARDED amount
